reviews.comment:
Buscaba un lugar tranquilo con buena iluminación sin perder la vista increíble de la Villa y sin dudas fue el indicado. Necesitaba tener una reunión virtual de trabajo y fue el lugar perfecto, para los remoteworkers es un básico indispensable.
Super limpio, ordenado, la arquitectura acorde a la villa, ventanales gigantes.
En cuanto al personal: las chicas súper atentas y amables, baños impecables completos.
Me sorprendió el precio de la carta de cafetería [es acotada pero suficiente] súper accesible, sin dudas es un lugar para repetir a diario. Soy celiaca: hay opciones para refrigerio.

(Translated by Google)
I was looking for a quiet place with good lighting without losing the incredible view of the Villa, and this was definitely the one. I needed to have a virtual work meeting, and it was the perfect spot; for remote workers, it's an essential. Super clean and tidy, the architecture complements the Villa, and the windows are huge.
As for the staff: the women were incredibly attentive and friendly, and the bathrooms were spotless and fully equipped. I was surprised by the price of the coffee menu [it's limited but sufficient]—very affordable. It's definitely a place I'll return to every day. I'm celiac, so there are snack options available.
